full_judgment: 14. Exhibit-ka and ka(1) are mutated khatians in the name of Golam Mustafa Bhuiyan, seller opposite party No. 2 and Exhibit-kha (1) is a Rent Receipt manifesting payment of rent by pre-emptee petitioner and Exhibit-kha (2) is a niutated Khatian in the name of pre-emptee-petitioner, Except those documents no other documents had been produced from the side of pre-emptee-petitioner evidencing that for sub-division of the joint tenancy application was filed before Revenue Officer and notices upon co-sharers had been issued and co-sharers had been heard in the alleged sub-division matter. In the absence of those it cannot be at all suggested that the joint tenancy had been sub-divided and a separate Jama and tenancy had been created in the name of seller opposite party and pre-emptee-petitioner. There cannot be any sub-division of holding and splitting up of Jama unless requirements of law embodied in section 117 (1) (c) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act have been complied with.
